e02-ana-washes-her-hands-before-dinner.observed_description: Ana, in the sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans, stands at a white sink with a black faucet on the left wall counter of a warm lamp-lit kitchen, smiling at the camera and washing soapy hands under running water; a dusk-blue window behind her. On the right, a wooden table holds an untouched plate of chicken, rice and vegetables, a fork on a napkin and a glass of water. Identity, evening light, hands and the waiting dinner all read in the full 3:2 frame.
e02-ana-washes-her-hands-before-dinner.rejection: The sink and the plate sit outside the central 55 percent, so the centered 4:5 crop used by the four-picture grids (R7, R9, A5, A7, A8) drops the waiting dinner completely and cuts her soapy hands in half at the left edge; the tile no longer shows washing hands, let alone before dinner.

e06-ana-is-busy-at-work.observed_description: Ana, in the sage-green overshirt over a white top, sits at a light-oak office desk in warm sunlight, smiling at the camera and pointing down with one index finger at two tall untidy stacks of folders; her other hand holds a pen on an open folder, a closed grey laptop lies at the far end of the desk and her brown tote sits on the navy chair beside her; plants and an oak shelf of binders behind. Reads as too much work at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps her face, the pointing hand and most of the stacks. Her smile is more cheerful than apologetic, which is acceptable.

e07-ana-says-ok-at-work.observed_description: Ana stands behind her tidy light-oak office desk with her brown leather tote on her shoulder, smiling, giving one clear thumbs-up at chest height (four fingers curled, thumb straight up); a grey laptop open with its plain back to the camera, a green folder, a plant and a pen cup on the desk; navy chair at left, window, plants and binder shelves behind. The thumbs-up reads at 250 px and still shows at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps her whole upper body. The laptop is open although the prompt asked for it closed; the tote on her shoulder still says she is leaving.

e01-ana-eats-lunch-at-work.observed_description: Ana, in the sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans, sits at a small round light-wood table in a bright, plant-filled break area at midday, smiling as she takes a bite from half a sandwich held in both hands; a white plate with the other half and a green salad and one glass of water on the table. The top-right corner is window and wall with no face or hand in it, so the two lunch clocks have room. Reads as eating lunch at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps her, the sandwich and the plate.

e03-luis-cooks-dinner-after-he-arrives-h.observed_description: Luis, in the navy crew-neck T-shirt and khaki chinos, stands at a white gas stove in his grey-blue kitchen at dusk, smiling at the camera as he stirs chicken and vegetables in a frying pan with a wooden spoon; steam rises, a pot of rice sits behind the pan, his keys lie on the white counter and his black backpack sits on a chair at the empty wooden table. Reads as cooking at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps him, the pan and the rice but drops the backpack and table, which only matter in the full 3:2 frame. A very faint head-and-shoulders shadow in the right window pane looks like a reflection; it is invisible at 360 px and below, so it is noted for the human review rather than rejected.

e04-luis-cleans-the-kitchen-after-dinner.observed_description: Luis, in the navy T-shirt and khaki chinos, leans over a small butcher-block table in his grey-blue kitchen at night (dark blue window) and wipes it with a blue cloth, smiling; on the table a used white plate with a sauce smear and leftover rice, a used fork and an empty glass; a used frying pan and a rice cooker wait by the sink behind him. Reads as cleaning after dinner at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps him, the cloth and the dirty plate. The stove sits under the window here while e03 puts the sink there, a small layout difference between the two shots of his kitchen.

e05-ana-reads-after-dinner.observed_description: Ana, in the sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans, sits relaxed on a light-grey sofa in a lamp-lit living room with a dark blue window, smiling as she reads an open book held in both hands; on the wooden coffee table in front of her an empty white plate with crumbs and a fork, a crumpled napkin and a glass of water. Reads as reading after dinner at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps the book, the empty plate and her face near the left edge, trimming her hair and shoulder.
